name: Road Trip
gm_moves: offer a detour that matters to one traveler and costs time to the whole group
let a host ask what the group plans to do after arriving
bring back somebody from an earlier stop who now needs a ride
give the travelers a quiet stretch to follow up on something said at the last stop
make arrival possible under terms one traveler wants to renegotiate
fits: old friends on one last drive together
a family retracing a route from childhood
travelers sharing rides across several towns
a touring band on a tiny budget
a delivery with a promise at each stop
a pilgrimage shaped by the people met along the way
checks: a ladder of 3+ steps that rise one after another
no empty story axis, and no seed fact contradicted
name the destination and the promise the travelers make about reaching it
give each stop a choice about the route, the schedule, or a relationship
let an earlier stop matter again before the travelers make their arrival decision
